name: Uta-Chan no Haru
source:
The story follows an ordinary girl, Kato Shi.
She has close friends she can trust, and a loving boyfriend she deeply cares for. Her life seems complete—peaceful and full of happiness.

And yet… deep within her heart, there lingers a subtle sense of something missing.

While helping her boyfriend, a photographer, she begins to meet all kinds of people and step into worlds she has never known before, experiencing a wide range of events and encounters.

Through these meetings and choices, she gradually comes to realize—
there is another side of herself she has never truly understood.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4291500/]Steam[/url]]
